cues.en: In this part of let's build a chatbot, we are going to talk about conversations.
cues.zh: 這個打造聊天機器人的單元，要介紹對話管理。

cues.en: So, the conversations we have in a chatbot, of course, often sits on the left side, where we can make a new chat,
cues.zh: 聊天機器人的對話通常放在左側，可以建立新對話，

cues.en: and we can switch between the existing ones and keep on prompting the LLM for more information on those chats.
cues.zh: 也能切換已有對話，繼續向 LLM 追問更多資訊。

cues.en: So, let's go in and see how I built this in the baseline of the Blazor server.
cues.zh: 接著看看 Blazor Server 基本版如何實作。

cues.en: So, one thing up front is that Agent Framework have something that is close to this by themselves,
cues.zh: 先說明，Agent Framework 本身也提供類似的功能，

cues.en: and they have a session format.
cues.zh: 也就是 Session 格式。

cues.en: So, you can say, create session, and begin to work with sessions.
cues.zh: 可以建立 Session，再透過它進行對話。

cues.en: Sessions is the thing that makes it possible to ask LLM, who is Elvis, and with a follow-up prompt say, how tall is he?
cues.zh: Session 能讓你先問 LLM「Elvis 是誰？」，再追問「他有多高？」。

cues.en: Just by putting in our new question, and the session will take care of the follow-up questions and so on.
cues.zh: 只要提供新問題，Session 會處理追問的上下文。

cues.en: But, as you can see here, or if you went through the code, you will see that there is no sessions here.
cues.zh: 不過看看這裡，或檢查程式碼，就會發現沒有使用 Session。

cues.en: In the process of building this baseline, I actually tried to use sessions, but they have a bunch of problems.
cues.zh: 建立基本版時，我其實試過 Session，但它有不少問題。

cues.en: So, sessions are essentially just the messages we get from a response.
cues.zh: Session 本質上就是回應中的訊息。

cues.en: And in order to do that, it is okay, because in a response, in a message,
cues.zh: 用來保存訊息本身沒有問題，因為在回應中，

cues.en: we get the content, we get the various back and forwards, the reasoning and everything.
cues.zh: 可以取得 Content、來回對話、推理等內容。

cues.en: But one thing we don't get in a raw message is actually usage.
cues.zh: 但原始訊息中缺少一個東西，就是 Usage。

cues.en: Here I'm showing my conversation version where we have to use it, but in the raw message that we see here, usage is not part of it.
cues.zh: 這裡顯示的是我的對話版本，因此有 Usage，但這邊原始訊息本身沒有。

cues.en: So, if we were to use agent sessions, we would not be able to do that.
cues.zh: 所以若直接使用 Agent Session，就無法保留這項資訊。

cues.en: Agent sessions, if we create one here, also have the drawback that
cues.zh: Agent Session 還有另一個缺點，假設在這裡建立，

cues.en: if we're using the responses API, we can't go into our session
cues.zh: 如果使用 Responses API，就無法直接從 Session，

cues.en: and say, get the chat history. We can't get the messages out.
cues.zh: 取得對話歷史，也不能直接取出訊息。

cues.en: We would need to use OpenAI's API to get the conversations up from the cloud.
cues.zh: 必須使用 OpenAI API，從雲端取得對話。

cues.en: And since it doesn't fit our things anyway, that would just be a hassle.
cues.zh: 反正也不符合需求，這樣只是更麻煩。

cues.en: But it could be done.
cues.zh: 不過確實做得到。

cues.en: Also, a session don't have an ID.
cues.zh: 另外，Session 沒有標準 ID。

cues.en: They can have IDs, but out of the box, there is no official ID.
cues.zh: 某些實作可以有 ID，但預設沒有統一的正式 ID。

cues.en: And there is not a title, as we did here.
cues.zh: 也沒有像這裡一樣的標題。

cues.en: We wanted to on the fly build a title.
cues.zh: 我們希望在需要時自動產生標題。

cues.en: We could use the state back and say, set value, so we can save more data.
cues.zh: 可以透過 StateBag 的 SetValue 儲存額外資料，

cues.en: But we can't save more data to the individual messages.
cues.zh: 但不能在個別訊息附加自己的資料。

cues.en: We can only do it for the entire session.
cues.zh: 只能附加在整個 Session 上。

cues.en: That would be okay for an ID and a title, but not for the usage.
cues.zh: ID 與標題這樣處理還可以，但 Usage 不適合。

cues.en: It's also incredible difficult to serialize and deserialize because behind the scenes, it needs to be done
cues.zh: 序列化與反序列化也很困難，因為背後需要透過，

cues.en: with some internal JSON format inside the agent.
cues.zh: 代理程式內部的特定 JSON 格式。

cues.en: So, we would need to send the agent and the session along all over the place.
cues.zh: 因此必須到處同時傳遞代理程式與 Session。

cues.en: It was just a hassle.
cues.zh: 真的很麻煩。

cues.en: And then I introduced what you're about to see, and everything became much more simple.
cues.zh: 後來改成接下來要看的做法，一切簡單很多。

cues.en: So, in my book, session is not if you just need to quickly get something back and forward,
cues.zh: 所以在我看來，Session 適合快速處理來回對話，

cues.en: but don't really use it as a storage of conversation.
cues.zh: 但不要直接拿來當完整對話的儲存格式。

cues.en: Not if you want the entire conversation including usage and stuff like that.
cues.zh: 尤其需要保留 Usage 等全部資訊時。

cues.en: I find it personally that I always roll my own custom conversation because it's just as easy.
cues.zh: 我自己總會建立自訂 Conversation，因為同樣很容易。

cues.en: The only thing you need to take care of is that whenever you actually call your agent, you need to send all the conversation history here
cues.zh: 唯一要自己處理的，是每次呼叫代理程式時，必須傳入完整對話歷史，

cues.en: instead of just sending the input plus session.
cues.zh: 而不是只傳新輸入與 Session。

cues.en: But essentially, behind the scenes, it's exactly what's going on behind the scenes when the real LM call happens.
cues.zh: 但實際呼叫 LLM 時，背後做的事情本來就相同。

cues.en: So, to me, sessions are not worth doing.
cues.zh: 所以對我來說，Session 不值得使用。

cues.en: So, what are we doing instead?
cues.zh: 那改成怎麼做呢？

cues.en: Well, we are building a conversation.
cues.zh: 自己建立 Conversation。

cues.en: So, if we look at a conversation, it's just a list of messages, which is not the chat messages from Microsoft's Extensions AI,
cues.zh: 看看 Conversation，它只是一組訊息清單，但不是單純使用 Microsoft.Extensions.AI 的 ChatMessage，

cues.en: but more slightly advanced one, where we have the raw message plus the usage.
cues.zh: 而是多包裝一層，包含原始訊息與 Usage。

cues.en: So, behind the scenes, we're storing the out-of-the-box agent framework content, but just in a wrapper where we can have multiple things at the same time.
cues.zh: 因此背後仍保存 Agent Framework 原本的 Content，只是用包裝物件，同時保留其他資訊。

cues.en: And I've just put in a few extra parameters here so it's easy, so I don't need to call that raw message dot something.
cues.zh: 也加入幾個方便屬性，避免每次都要透過 RawMessage 再讀取內容。

cues.en: So, we're storing those messages, and we're storing an ID, and we're storing a title.
cues.zh: 因此保存訊息、ID，以及標題。

cues.en: So, it's very easy for us to add multiple things to this.
cues.zh: 也很容易再加入其他資料。

cues.en: But, of course, it means that we need to take care of whenever we make our conversation to remember to put in the new input, and whenever we're done with our message,
cues.zh: 但這表示建立對話時，要記得自行加入使用者新輸入，並在取得回應後，

cues.en: to put in the new output to the conversation, meaning all the messages from the response.
cues.zh: 把新的輸出加入對話，也就是回應中的全部訊息。

cues.en: An agent session would have done that on the fly itself, but a small hassle to put in those two things in order to get a better overall solution.
cues.zh: Agent Session 原本會自動完成，但為了取得更好的整體方案，自己多寫這兩個操作並不麻煩。

cues.en: Once we have that, it's just JSON.
cues.zh: 有了這些物件，剩下就是 JSON。

cues.en: So, in my case, I'm saving it down into a temp folder.
cues.zh: 這個範例把它們存入暫存資料夾。

cues.en: In a real-life system, we would probably put them inside a Cosmos DB, a SQL server, a blob storage, or whatever we would like to do.
cues.zh: 真實系統中，可能存到 Cosmos DB、SQL Server、Blob Storage，或任何適合的地方。

cues.en: We're giving them names here, which is just the ID, which is just a GUID.
cues.zh: 檔案名稱使用 ID，也就是 GUID。

cues.en: And in order to work with them, we need some GUI, and we need a little service.
cues.zh: 要操作這些對話，還需要介面與一個小服務。

cues.en: So, we have this conversation service, which can load the previous messages.
cues.zh: 因此有 ConversationService，可以載入先前訊息。

cues.en: Nothing revolutionary. We're just going to our conversation folder, which is this temp folder.
cues.zh: 沒有特別的技術，只是進入對話資料夾，也就是這個暫存資料夾。

cues.en: In my case, I call it Blazor server only conversations.
cues.zh: 這裡命名為 Blazor Server Only Conversations。

cues.en: And we're just getting all files that are JSON, and reading all the text, and turning it up.
cues.zh: 取得所有 JSON 檔案，讀取文字，再反序列化。

cues.en: So, this is plain C-sharp.
cues.zh: 因此只是一般 C#。

cues.en: So, we do that whenever we open the left sidebar.
cues.zh: 每次開啟左側側邊欄，就執行這些操作。

cues.en: So, the left sidebar is just a list of conversations, and every one of them is a small button.
cues.zh: 左側側邊欄就是對話清單，每個對話是一個小按鈕。

cues.en: So, when we click that button, we can switch to that conversation.
cues.zh: 按下按鈕就能切換對話。

cues.en: Meaning, putting that object into context as the current conversation.
cues.zh: 也就是把該物件設為目前對話。

cues.en: And behind the scenes, loading it is just doing UninitializeAsync, grabbing the conversation.
cues.zh: 載入時，只是在 OnInitializedAsync 中取得對話。

cues.en: So, there's no rocket science here at all.
cues.zh: 完全沒有什麼高深的東西。

cues.en: It's just a plain JSON object, or a list of them.
cues.zh: 就是一般 JSON 物件，或一組物件清單。

cues.en: To have that the conversations keep up to date, of course, we need to, after we have created our response back,
cues.zh: 為了讓對話保持最新，每次取得回應後，

cues.en: we need to store the conversation.
cues.zh: 都需要保存對話。

cues.en: So, inside of these, we add it to the conversation, and then we are just storing the current conversation now.
cues.zh: 因此這裡把訊息加入對話，再儲存目前對話。

cues.en: And again, that's just civilizing it down into the system.
cues.zh: 同樣地，只是序列化後寫入系統。

cues.en: And we end up with these files, or something in a database, nothing special.
cues.zh: 最後就會有這些檔案，或資料庫裡的資料，沒有其他特別之處。

cues.en: But again, I urge you to make your own, take the extra time to make an object for yourself, instead of just trying to use the agent session.
cues.zh: 但我建議多花一點時間建立自己的物件，不要只是想直接使用 Agent Session。

cues.en: I found it to go from annoying, and all kinds of things back and forward, to very, very simple,
cues.zh: 我發現這樣能把原本惱人、到處來回處理的流程，變得非常簡單，

cues.en: and add your own extra tools, like missing a title, and such things, instead of hassling around with an agent session.
cues.zh: 而且可以自行加入標題等額外功能，不必一直遷就 Agent Session。

cues.en: So, that is everything for this video.
cues.zh: 這支影片的內容就是這些。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
